name: East Troublesome 2020 (run of 21-23 Oct)
ignition_source: protocol A18 start from an outline: the NASA FEDS outline labelled 2020-10-21T12:00 (afternoon passes, 123.0 km2), timed by protocol A19 at its last VIIRS pass, 21:10Z 21 Oct 2020 (data/east_troublesome_2020/perimeters/progression_NASA_FEDS_passtimes.geojson)

ignition.source: not an ignition: the start outline's centroid, used only as the point where station weather is interpolated and for charts

hours_note: to 6 hours after the 23 Oct 00:00-label outline's pass time (10:00Z 23 Oct) = 16:00Z 23 Oct, 42.8 h, rounded up to whole hours (protocol A18 note of 25 Nov)
box_note: the final perimeter's bounding box plus about 5 km

landfire.units_source: data/east_troublesome_2020/landfire/VERSION.md: LF 2016 Remap fuels (fallback), CC %, CH m x 10, CBH m x 10, CBD kg/m3 x 100

live_moisture_note: Scott and Burgan 2005 live scenario L1 (fully cured herbaceous 30 %, woody 60 %): an assumption for late October after a drought summer, not a measurement. Protocol amendment A5.
stations_note: the six stations of data/east_troublesome_2020/weather/stations.json, read from weather_wide (fetch_weather_wide.py, pad 0.75, window ignition-3 h to +43 h)

buildings.note: USGS CC0 release (doi 10.5066/P1QX6UXD): the pre-fire building points. Buildings inside the start outline count as burned at minute 0 only if the model lights them; houses are reported, not part of the A18 reading.
